our_argument_summary: Unchanged from c4. kernel_of_truth.description: Unchanged from c4. The dome model's H(r) = 8,537 × exp(−r/8,619) construction is genuinely sophisticated curve-fitting that unifies Schumann (~9,500 km), Polaris (~4,750 km), and model-average (~9,086 km) firmament heights into one exponential (data/wins.json:056.detail_verdict_text). kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Unchanged from c4. deeper_analysis: Verification cycle for ISS-2888 (the c4 hole_index=0). I flag it as a summary_for_decider note for tinker rather than re-opening it as a hole.
